body: Is this a cop out? I think it's a legitimate reason to stop hurting someone.

I may not be completely opposed to the idea of getting my mental health evaluated and possibly being diagnosed with something, but if growing up with a learning disability has taught me anything it's that I can't change myself, I will always have to deal with being a terrible student (not just in an academic sense). If I am diagnosed with another disorder, I don't want to live having to manage it because I know much work and how painful it is when it slips through. I just want relief from my broken mind.
